name: chat.airys/mcp
title: AirysChat MCP Server
description: Operate AirysChat — conversations, CRM, AI Agents, Meta Business Agent, and WhatsApp campaigns.

environmentVariables.name: AIRYSCHAT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the AirysChat instance (e.g. https://airys.chat)

environmentVariables.name: AIRYSCHAT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: AirysChat API access token (or scoped MCP token)

environmentVariables.name: AIRYSCHAT_FEATURES
environmentVariables.description: Highest tool maturity tier exposed (stable, beta, experimental)

environmentVariables.name: AIRYSCHAT_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 or true to disable all write tools
